rca_of_issue: Repro: Open Chapter 3 -> select Live Event tab -> tap event handoff CTA near lower viewport. Expected: `event-reset-button` appears. Actual (intermittent but repeated): reset button not found and waitlist sheet appears, suggesting persistent bottom dock intercepts click/touch in overlapping area. Mitigation: ensure sufficient bottom spacing/safe clickable zone for event controls or adjust dock pointer handling/z-index while interacting with workspace controls.
